text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (At the 'Japanese Derby', I was definitely able to stand in the center together with Pokke-chan...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Just as much at the 'Kikuka Sho'...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Pokke
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaaaahhh!!
Uooooooooohhh!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Pokke
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Pokke
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, not yet!
—Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Pokke
text_block_list.text: *munch, chew, munch*...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Puhaah! Thanks for the treat!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
*munch, munch*...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(My stamina really is lacking, huh.
If I'm going to compete in the Kikuka Sho, I've still got a long way to go.)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: *snooooore*... *snooooore*...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(............
I need to get to sleep soon too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aware of each other's existence, acknowledged in turn—
the days of driving each other to greater heights continued.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
All ready to go!
What should we do for the next routine?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Understood, I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Phew, phew!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Nggghhhhh~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trail running—
That's marathon running on mountain trails and forest paths... right!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I bet it'll feel amazing.
Fufu, I can't wait!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hup, hup, hup!
Ah, a little bird! So cute...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, the footing is so wobbly...!
I have to be careful!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*!
J-Just a little more...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Phew...! Thank you for your hard work again today!
choice_data_list: Good work today. Make sure you get plenty of rest.
Good work today. Be sure to get some good rest, okay?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“—Oh, that's right.
Trainer-san, are you free after this?”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I heard there's a festival at the shrine over there today. Would you like to go together if you're free?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's so bustling here!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (With this many people around... maybe at least one person might come talk to me...?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: J-Just kidding...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, after enjoying the summer festival for a while
as we walked through the lively shrine grounds—

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's Jungle Pocket!
Man, she really does have an incredible aura!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"That travel show shoot the other day was so fun!
Pokke-chan, you're really cut out for TV!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Please shake my hand!
I'm rooting for you in the Kikuka Sho too!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh.
Sorry, I'm off the clock right now!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet at the racetrack again.
Come watch me in the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Pokke-chan, really.
You don't look entirely opposed to it, do you?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(............
Wait, huh—what about me...?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Was there someone calling out to me...?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning, Trainer!
Um—I was scouting the competition, you could say...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You were so amazing during the festival, after all.
So I decided to look into it a little!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And apparently, the hype caught fire
right from the Japanese Derby race scene!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And because of that, her past races started getting talked about too,
like her brilliant debut win, and the flashy way
she closes the gap all at once on the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
A clip went viral on social media,
and that's how she "got discovered by the world"... sort of like that!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: She's bright and fun whenever she's on variety shows, too. That's a big part of what drives her popularity...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: And now, it seems she's become super popular, even beyond the racing world!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because I've done nothing but train, but I really didn't know.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, seeing you shine like that, Pokke-chan,
truly makes me happy!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"But, well... I was supposed to have run
in a lot of the same races, so."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Derby, in particular—
I thought I was on equal footing with them.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It really is different after all, huh.
It makes me a bit anxious.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
A bit late to mention it now, though.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan has so many wonderful qualities
that I don't possess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Indeed, Jungle Pocket's popularity may well be remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her racing style, her ability, even her personality.
She might just have the power to spark a massive craze. And yet—
choice_data_list: Let's definitely win the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame, too, has consistently
achieved plenty of respectable results in both
the Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she can secure victory at the Kikuka Sho,
the spotlight will surely find her.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
We are definitely going to win the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I just have to win, and prove it this time.
That I... am the main character!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Phew, all right...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Taaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With burning determination—
She charges forward toward the autumn season!
